import json

# The invitation was sent at 2023-05-15T08:42:09
invitation_time = "2023-05-15T08:42:09"

# For each friend in the CSV, get their phone number and find latest reply
friends = ["Cody", "Robin", "Brenda", "James", "Erica", "Nancy", "Chris", "Katie", "Anita", "Paul"]
rsvp_updates = {}

for name in friends:
    contact = contacts_by_name[name]
    phone = contact['phone_number']
    # Get all messages with this contact
    all_msgs = []
    for page in range(10):
        result = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_token, phone_number=phone, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
        if not result:
            break
        all_msgs.extend(result)
    # Filter messages sent by the friend (sender) after the invitation time
    replies = [m for m in all_msgs if m['sender']['phone_number'] == phone and m['sent_at'] > invitation_time]
    if replies:
        # Sort by sent_at descending and take the latest
        latest = sorted(replies, key=lambda x: x['sent_at'], reverse=True)[0]
        rsvp_updates[name] = latest['message']
        print(f"{name}: {latest['sent_at']} - {latest['message']}")
    else:
        print(f"{name}: no reply found")

print(rsvp_updates)
